Archiving a nomologR workflow with nomo_report()

Source: vignettes/reproducible-report.Rmd
reproducible-report.Rmd

nomo_report() is the final presentation and provenance layer in the v0.1 workflow.

It does not rerun the analyses. It renders the evidence and researcher decisions already stored in a nomo_run object.

Render a report 

report_file <- nomo_report(
  run,
  file = "construct-validation-report.html"
)

report_file

The HTML file is self-contained so it can be archived, attached to a project record, or shared with a collaborator without a separate figures directory or MathJax network dependency. The title argument becomes the document title:

nomo_report(
  run,
  file = "construct-validation-report.html",
  title = "Construct validation audit"
)

What the report contains

The Milestone 9 report mirrors the full guided workflow:

  1. researcher inputs and data/sample roles;
  2. item audit;
  3. factor-retention evidence;
  4. EFA;
  5. CFA;
  6. reliability;
  7. convergent/discriminant evidence;
  8. invariance, if requested;
  9. nomological-network evidence, if requested;
  10. workflow decisions and outstanding decisions;
  11. deviations and post-hoc decisions;
  12. software/method citations;
  13. reproducibility information and session details.

A final evidence-trace appendix keeps each autogenerated recommendation on the same row as the component, metric, reference, severity, and observation that produced it.

Reports from incomplete workflows

A report can also be rendered from a paused or blocked workflow:

nomo_report(
  paused_run,
  file = "paused-workflow-audit.html"
)

Missing stages are labeled as incomplete/not requested rather than silently disappearing.

This is useful when a researcher wants to archive why an analysis stopped or what consequential decision remained unresolved.

Plots and session information 

nomo_report(
  run,
  file = "compact-report.html",
  include_plots = FALSE,
  include_session = FALSE
)

The default includes a compact, nonredundant set of plots and full sessionInfo() output.

Overwriting is explicit

Existing reports are protected:

nomo_report(
  run,
  file = "construct-validation-report.html",
  overwrite = TRUE
)

As elsewhere in nomologR, consequential or destructive behavior is not silently assumed.
